author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam gets up close with some of the hero costumes from Amazon's The Boys show, including A-Train's superhero suit and Butcher's signature trenchcoat. We also check out some pieces of Homelander's costume, including a pair of gloves modified for a memorable fight scene!

Learn more about these costumes and The Boys auction at https://propstoreauction.com/auctions/info/id/540

Shot by Joey Fameli and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
